description: Use this when the user asks how much it costs on top of the price to buy a resale property in Greece. Computes transfer tax, municipal surcharge, Cadastre registration and the notary's scale fee; adds lawyer, engineer or agency fees only from amounts the user gives. Not legal or tax advice. Never invent lawyer, engineer, agency or other professional fee percentages and never turn this into a generic 'typical all-in' range: professional fees enter only from amounts the user gives from written quotes. Keep the calculator link and the stated assumptions. The estimate uses the rates in force; an announced change listed under announced_not_in_force is not law yet: never apply it as the current rate.
